tools.name: figure_persona_current
tools.description: Report the figure pack the host is showing, the persona profile in effect, and how many profiles exist.

summary.zh: 报当前正在显示的形象包、生效的人设档,以及这个形象一共有几档。
summary.en: Reports the figure pack in use, the persona profile in effect, and how many profiles the figure has.

tools.name: figure_persona_switch
tools.description: Switch to another persona profile of the current figure pack, or to another installed figure, then reload the system prefix.

figure.description: Figure pack id; omit to keep the current one.

profile.description: Persona profile name; omit to use the profile already in effect.

summary.zh: 切到当前形象的另一档人设,或换一个已装形象,然后重载系统前缀。
summary.en: Switches to another persona profile of the current figure, or to another installed figure, then reloads the system prefix.

description.zh: World 挂载完成,附当前形象与人格文本的来源。
description.en: The World was mounted, with the current figure and where its persona text came from.

prompts.title: 形象人格 · 环境提示词
